customManagers.description: Update ARGs annotated with '# renovate: datasource=… depName=…'. The Dockerfiles compose their FROM refs from a registry variable and a digest-pinned tag, which the dockerfile manager cannot replace; tag and digest are captured separately so digest-pinned ARGs stay managed.

packageRules.description: The annotated-ARG manager owns the composed base images and the opencode pin.
Bare versions are reused outside the FROM line; digests are captured explicitly.
The agent image and the mise pin must move together: one OpenCode version is what the workbench, the probe and the image share.
webgrip/workflows cuts no tags for its main pin; a tag lookup 404 aborts the whole run.
